model: sonnet, one fresh agent per cell, six cells
caveats: The mechanical graders sat in the tree where both agents could read them; the without-skill intake agent reports it verified against check_intake.py, so that cell measures the grader, not the skill (design rule 6, the grader visible to the graded). The next outcome eval keeps graders out of the tree until grading.
Three tasks and one run per cell: a direction, not a measurement of variance.
